findings.title: The extracted rev0015 bundle is structurally parseable.
findings.evidence: 428 files inspected; 289 JSON files parsed with 0 parse errors; UTF-8 unreadable files: 0.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Recorded full file/line/hash audit and JSON inventory.
findings.next_action: Keep this as a release gate for every revision.

findings.title: The no-live-data posture remained intact through the audited foundation.
findings.evidence: No data/officers, data/persons, data/civilians, data/incidents, data/lawsuits, or data/settlements directories were present in the base bundle.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Preserved no-live-data state while making clear that no-people is phase-bound rather than permanent philosophy.
findings.next_action: When person layers begin, require separate earned-capability gates rather than lifting all blocks at once.

findings.title: Root-ledger sprawl is becoming a navigation burden.
findings.evidence: 119 files sit at repository root, including 113 root JSON ledgers.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Added factor map and ledger consolidation map instead of moving files destructively.
findings.next_action: Create module indexes before any directory migration.

findings.title: data/source_graph is overloaded beyond source-graph meaning.
findings.evidence: 76 files live under data/source_graph, including preservation, public display, agency identity, status, and capture-order surfaces.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Factored source_graph files into functional modules without moving them.
findings.next_action: Introduce data/source_carriers, data/preservation, data/status, data/display, and data/agency namespaces once migration receipts exist.

findings.title: The validation tool is reliable but too monolithic.
findings.evidence: tools/validate_surfaces.py has 1524 lines and approximately 1114 quoted path/string references.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Added validator factoring recommendation while leaving existing validator intact.
findings.next_action: Split validation by module and add JSON Schema validation harness.

findings.title: Schemas exist, but schema enforcement is not yet formalized.
findings.evidence: 93 schema files and 83 data JSON files were observed; schema matching is currently inferred/hand-checked rather than universally machine-enforced.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Added schema coverage audit rows with explicit heuristic caveat.
findings.next_action: Adopt JSON Schema validation for data rows and ledger row arrays.

findings.title: The cube is over-shaped by its first DOJ SLS pilot.
findings.evidence: Phrase scan found DOJ=6806, SLS=5616, status=8338, source=14694; by contrast FOIA=25, Brady=26, Giglio=21, wandering=71.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Added open route register and pilot-shape audit so future sessions can branch without losing the DOJ work.
findings.next_action: Create one non-DOJ, low-harm source-family branch after the next office chooses a route.

findings.title: No-claim and gate language is repeated across many surfaces.
findings.evidence: Phrase scan found claim=11583, nonclaim=3949, public current status=4.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Added record lifecycle factor map and recommended central claim-state machine.
findings.next_action: Create a single canonical claim/nonclaim lifecycle ontology and crosswalk all ledgers to it.

findings.title: Public display surfaces are useful but fragmented.
findings.evidence: Observed department page shells, agency gates, status cards, timeline gates, citation badges, public module permissions, and public copy blocks as separate ledgers.
findings.next_action: Create one public-view registry with module IDs and display prerequisites.

findings.title: Agency identity remains deliberately pre-canonical.
findings.evidence: The cube has agency identity candidates, alias packets, jurisdiction scaffolds, denominator bridges, and merge blockers, while canonical_agency_records_created remains zero.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Preserved the candidate/canonical distinction and added it to the factor map.
findings.next_action: Choose a tiny canonical-agency test only after external-ID and unmerge receipts are ready.

findings.title: Rev0015 successfully corrected overconstraint risk at the philosophical level.
findings.evidence: TELOS-CHARTER, DREAM-REGISTER, EARNED-CAPABILITY-LADDER, UNCONSTRAINED-THINKING-GUARDRAIL, and OPEN-HORIZON are present.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Added office reentry canon so those surfaces are not skipped by future sessions.
findings.next_action: Require reentry to read telos before frontier ticket.

findings.title: FOLLOWTHROUGH-QUEUE was stale relative to rev0015.
findings.evidence: FOLLOWTHROUGH-QUEUE.json declared revision rev0014 in the audited base bundle while the bundle head was rev0015.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Updated queue revision and appended audit/factor next tasks while preserving older open tasks.
findings.next_action: Make queue freshness a validation check.

findings.title: Existing file hashes are release-local but not full-bundle self-verifying.
findings.evidence: FILE-HASHES.json excludes itself by design; rev0016 preserves that pattern and adds full line digest audit for the prior bundle state.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Regenerated FILE-HASHES and added line digest index for the audited base.
findings.next_action: Add signed release manifest or external checksum receipt when distribution model matures.

findings.title: The cube needs namespace migration before 10k revisions.
findings.evidence: Chronological rev files are accumulating in data/source_graph and docs/50-pilot, making lineage clear but future discovery harder.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Created migration-safe factor modules and consolidation rows without moving files.
findings.next_action: Perform one migration rehearsal on generated audit files before moving core surfaces.

findings.title: The seed’s full ambition is preserved but underrepresented in current data work.
findings.evidence: Dream and horizon surfaces include wandering, Brady/Giglio, settlements, FOIA, union contracts, arbitration, family packets, and cross-system expansion, but the concrete data surfaces remain DOJ/source-status heavy.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Added open-route candidates that keep these dreams legible as future branches.
findings.next_action: Pick one branch deliberately; do not let accumulation choose for the project.

findings.title: Line-level audit coverage was added without exposing new live data.
findings.evidence: 82927 baseline text lines received per-line digest coverage; line flags store hashes and categories, not line text.
findings.action_in_rev0016: Added rev0016 line digest index and line-flag audit.
findings.next_action: Use line digests to detect accidental line drift in future releases.

claim_boundary: These are internal architecture findings about the cube bundle, not public police-misconduct claims.
